name: STARCOP train no-plume cross-modal supplement
research_question: Can the author-curated STARCOP AVIRIS-NG train no-plume class supply at least 28 leakage-safe, near-simultaneous Sentinel-2 L1C or Landsat 8/9 Level-1 negatives without downloading the 60.8 GB imagery release?

decision_context_disclosed_before_freeze.anti_pooling_boundary: STARCOP must pass every metadata gate and later contribute at least 28 qualifying target pairs by itself. It may not pool with CACH4, COVID, Permian, or another candidate supplement to satisfy either gate.
decision_context_disclosed_before_freeze.reason_for_parallel_route: STARCOP exposes a hash-bound 1 MB train manifest and georeferenced per-chip zero masks in open Zenodo train archives, permitting sparse byte-range access while the NASA header route awaits authentication.

source.dataset: STARCOP: Semantic Segmentation of Methane Plumes with Hyperspectral Machine Learning Models
source.negative_semantics: Dataset-author no-plume training windows. The official generator removes windows intersecting known annotations and explicitly marks additional missed plume windows before assigning has_plume=false. This means no annotated/refined plume in the released benchmark window, not physical zero methane.

stage_a_train_manifest.forbidden_content: No test manifest, archive member, hyperspectral band, matched-filter raster, RGB, or target catalog.
stage_a_train_manifest.id_contract: Each retained ID must match angYYYYMMDDtHHMMSS_r{row}_c{column}_w{width}_h{height}; UTC is parsed exactly from the flight prefix.
stage_a_train_manifest.label_contract: Retain only has_plume=false rows. Do not rank or select negatives using qplume, matched-filter statistics, geography, or a model outcome.
stage_a_train_manifest.deterministic_sparse_selection: Within each negative-bearing flightline, select up to four IDs with the lexicographically smallest SHA-256(id UTF-8) digest. This selection is frozen before any chip coordinate is known.
stage_a_train_manifest.failure_action: Stop before archive-range access and report the source as insufficient.

permitted_network_content: HTTP response headers and ZIP end/central-directory bytes for the six exact train archives
the exact compressed bytes needed to reconstruct labelbinary.tif for deterministic selected train-negative IDs
forbidden_network_content: any test archive or test manifest
any radiance, reflectance, simulated WorldView-3, RGB, mag1c, or other imagery product
any target satellite catalog or asset
label_and_grid_validation: GeoTIFF is exactly 512 by 512 with one finite geotransform and projected CRS
every pixel is zero, confirming the released train no-plume class
chip center converts to finite WGS84 longitude and latitude
eligibility_filters: released has_plume is false and zero mask is confirmed
coordinate belongs to a deterministic selected row
strictly farther than 25 km from every official MARS-S2L test representative location
strictly farther than 25 km from every already-counted MARS-Hyperspectral negative source crop
stage_b_sparse_zero_mask_georeferencing.grouping: Transitive connected components of eligible centers with an undirected edge at haversine distance <=25.0 km.
stage_b_sparse_zero_mask_georeferencing.failure_action: Retire STARCOP as a supplement without changing a threshold or pooling another candidate source.
stage_b_sparse_zero_mask_georeferencing.pass_action: Commit a separate target-catalog protocol before any Sentinel-2 or Landsat query.

claim_boundary: A pass would establish sparse train-negative metadata feasibility only. It would not prove physical zero methane, coincident target yield, cross-sensor validity, model complementarity, calibration, or superiority over MARS-S2L.
